title: Paint It, Black
lyrics:
[00:14.97]I see a red door and I want it painted black
[00:21.03]No colours anymore, I want them to turn black
[00:27.07]I see the girls walk by dressed in their summer clothes
[00:33.18]I have to turn my head until my darkness goes
[00:39.29]I see a line of cars and they're all painted black
[00:45.30]With flowers and my love, both never to come back
[00:51.28]I see people turn their heads and quickly look away
[00:57.30]Like a newborn baby, it just happens everyday
[01:03.36]I look inside myself and see my heart is black
[01:09.41]I see my red door and must have it painted black
[01:15.42]Maybe then I'll fade away and not have to face the facts
[01:21.32]It's not easy facing up when your whole world is black
[01:27.57]No more will my green sea go turn a deeper blue
[01:33.86]I could not foresee this thing happening to you
[01:40.04]If I look hard enough into the setting sun
[01:46.19]My love will laugh with me before the morning comes
[01:52.19]I see a red door and I want it painted black
[01:58.33]No colours anymore, I want them to turn black
[02:04.25]I see the girls walk by dressed in their summer clothes
[02:10.34]I have to turn my head until my darkness goes
[02:39.04]I wanna see it painted, painted black
[02:42.97]Black as night, black as coal
[02:45.81]I wanna see the sun blotted out from the sky
[02:51.10]I wanna see it painted, painted, painted, painted black
[02:56.43]Yeah
